title: Acute Anaphylaxis
locator: Management and prevention of cardiac arrest due to anaphylaxis
scope: Adult emergency anaphylaxis; the 2021 detailed algorithm supplies monitoring. Saudi adaptation and complete prescribing review pending.

investigations.question: Recognise anaphylaxis promptly
investigations.finding: Compromise can occur without skin changes

actions.instruction: Remove the trigger if feasible; give early IV crystalloid and assess response.

medicines.frequency: Repeat if no improvement within 5 minutes
medicines.duration: Until emergency reassessment; further duration not specified
adjustments: Full contraindication and adjustment list not specified in this excerpt; review the detailed RCUK guideline and local formulary.

gaps: Detailed investigations, refractory infusion regimen and complete contraindication review are not extracted. This is a limited adult scope.

title: Acute Appendicitis
scope: Historical open-access evidence candidate. The 2025 WSES edition exists; reconciliation is mandatory before adoption. No historical dose promoted as current.

investigations.test: Clinical risk stratification and ultrasound when imaging indicated
investigations.question: Assess appendicitis probability
investigations.finding: Interpret findings with age, sex and clinical assessment

actions.instruction: Discuss antibiotics as an alternative for selected uncomplicated appendicitis without an appendicolith, including recurrence and failure risks.
For appendectomy, use preoperative broad-spectrum prophylaxis; uncomplicated disease does not require postoperative antibiotics in this edition.

gaps: Specific current drug selection, dose, route, contraindications and duration require retrieval of the newer 2025 edition and local antimicrobial policy. No dose inferred from the older edition.

title: Acute Bowel Obstruction
sourceTitle: WSES Bologna guidelines: adhesive small bowel obstruction
scope: Adhesive small-bowel obstruction only; does not cover all causes of bowel obstruction.

investigations.question: Identify obstruction and bowel compromise
investigations.finding: Closed loop, ischaemia or free fluid may require surgery without delay

investigations.test: Blood count, lactate, electrolytes, CRP and BUN/creatinine
investigations.question: Assess complications and dehydration

actions.instruction: Non-operative treatment is unsuitable with peritonitis, strangulation or ischaemia; otherwise use bowel rest, decompression and fluid/electrolyte correction.
A non-operative trial up to 72 hours is considered appropriate in eligible patients; deterioration requires earlier reassessment.
actions.timeframe: Up to 72 hours; not a compulsory waiting period

gaps: No complete named-drug regimen or precise fluid dose extracted; local prescribing review required.

title: Acute Coronary Syndrome
scope: Adult confirmed ACS; loading dose only. Broader antithrombotic and reperfusion protocols are not extracted.

actions.instruction: Unstable NSTEMI or unstable angina requires immediate coronary angiography.

medicines.indication: STEMI, NSTEMI or unstable angina initial loading
medicines.route: Not specified in these recommendations; local protocol required
adjustments: Exclude aspirin allergy; assess bleeding risk. Full prescribing adjustments require local review.

gaps: Route and subsequent maintenance dose not specified here; no antithrombin dose inferred.

title: Acute Coronary Syndrome Assessment and Escalation Pathway
scope: Adult NSTEMI/unstable-angina assessment; not an undifferentiated chest-pain algorithm.

investigations.test: ECG, troponin, creatinine, glucose and haemoglobin
investigations.question: Risk stratification

actions.instruction: Immediate angiography for instability; consider angiography within 72 hours when predicted 6-month mortality exceeds 3% and there are no angiography contraindications.
actions.timeframe: Immediate or within 72 hours according to eligibility

gaps: This assessment scope does not duplicate the ACS drug extraction. Complete medicine doses and contraindication review remain pending.

title: Acute Exacerbation of COPD
scope: Adults admitted with COPD exacerbation; steroid dose only. Antibiotics are conditional and are not implied for every exacerbation.

investigations.test: Chest X-ray, arterial blood gases, ECG, full blood count and urea/electrolytes
investigations.question: Assess severity and comorbidity
investigations.finding: Record inspired oxygen with blood gases

actions.instruction: Use non-invasive ventilation for persistent hypercapnic ventilatory failure despite optimal medical therapy.
actions.timeframe: When persistent ventilatory failure is identified

adjustments: Significant contraindications must be excluded; individual conditions and dose adjustments are not enumerated in this recommendation.
monitoring: Specific drug monitoring not specified in this recommendation; local prescribing review required.

gaps: No bronchodilator or antibiotic dose inferred. Complete contraindication list and local formulary review pending.

title: Acute Heart Failure and Pulmonary Oedema
scope: New suspected adult acute heart failure; no complete individual prescription extracted.

investigations.question: Exclude new acute heart failure
investigations.finding: BNP below 100 ng/L or NT-proBNP below 300 ng/L supports exclusion

investigations.test: Transthoracic echocardiography when natriuretic peptides raised
investigations.question: Identify cardiac abnormalities
investigations.finding: Establish presence or absence of abnormalities

actions.instruction: Use IV diuretic therapy with renal-function, weight and urine-output monitoring; no precise diuretic dose is specified here.
Avoid routine nitrates; selected IV use requires close BP monitoring with at least level 2 care. Do not use sodium nitroprusside.

gaps: Named diuretic, exact dose, frequency and complete contraindications are absent from these recommendations; no furosemide dose inferred.

title: Acute Ischemic Stroke
sourceTitle: NICE NG128: Stroke and TIA in over 16s
scope: Initial aspirin pathway after haemorrhage excluded; reperfusion-specific exclusions and antiplatelet timing require specialist review.

investigations.question: Exclude intracranial haemorrhage
investigations.finding: Imaging must exclude haemorrhage before this aspirin pathway
investigations.timeframe: Immediately when urgent criteria apply; otherwise within 24 hours

investigations.question: Assess oral medication safety
investigations.timeframe: Before oral food, fluid or medication

actions.instruction: Select oral aspirin when no dysphagia; use rectal or enteral-tube administration when dysphagia is present.
actions.timeframe: After brain imaging and swallowing assessment

medicines.indication: Acute stroke after intracerebral haemorrhage excluded
medicines.group: Adults; reperfusion-specific timing needs specialist confirmation
medicines.route: Oral without dysphagia; rectal or enteral tube with dysphagia
medicines.frequency: Daily; start as soon as possible and within 24 hours after required assessment
medicines.duration: Until 2 weeks after onset, or earlier transition on discharge
adjustments: Haemorrhage must be excluded. Full contraindication and post-thrombolysis timing review remains pending.

gaps: No thrombolytic dose inferred. Full allergy, bleeding and reperfusion-related restrictions require review.

title: Acute Kidney Injury
scope: Diagnostic assessment and restrictions on routine drug treatment; not a complete fluid or renal-replacement prescription.

investigations.test: Urine dipstick for blood, protein, leucocytes, nitrites and glucose
investigations.question: Assess AKI cause

investigations.test: Urinary tract ultrasound when obstruction possible or cause unclear
investigations.question: Detect obstruction or pyonephrosis
investigations.timeframe: Within 6 hours if pyonephrosis suspected; within 24 hours for unclear cause or obstruction risk

actions.instruction: Do not use low-dose dopamine for AKI; do not routinely use loop diuretics, except consider them for fluid overload in the specified renal-replacement/recovery settings.

gaps: No precise drug or fluid regimen supported in this scope; dose and contraindication review remains pending.

title: Acute Pancreatitis
scope: Diagnosis, infection prevention and nutrition; precise analgesia and fluid prescriptions are outside this extraction.

investigations.question: Support acute pancreatitis diagnosis
investigations.finding: Usually raised; elevations also occur in other conditions

investigations.test: Abdominal CT when enzyme elevations absent
investigations.question: Assess pancreatic inflammation
investigations.rationale: Support diagnosis when enzymes do not establish it

actions.instruction: Do not use prophylactic antimicrobials. Avoid withholding food without a clear reason, such as vomiting.
For moderately severe or severe disease, start enteral nutrition within 72 hours; parenteral nutrition is reserved for failed or contraindicated enteral nutrition.

gaps: No drug names or precise doses specified for supportive treatment here; no antibiotic or analgesic dose inferred.
